title: OpenAI Agents SDK
description: Python toolkit for agents that call tools, transfer tasks and record traces.
tradeoff: Confirms SDK hosting only. Model charges depend on the configured provider.

title: LangGraph
capabilities: durable execution,stateful agents,human in the loop
description: Build stateful agent workflows with persistent graph execution.
tradeoff: A graph defines control flow and state. Model requirements depend on the graph.

title: LangChain
description: Build agents with integrations for models, tools and retrieval systems.
tradeoff: Model and retrieval costs depend on the integrations selected.

title: CrewAI
description: Coordinate role-based agents and sequence workflows with flows.
tradeoff: Model requirements depend on the crew configuration.

title: Playwright
description: Control Chromium, Firefox and WebKit for browser automation and testing.
tradeoff: Browser binaries and system dependencies must match the target platform.

title: Playwright MCP
description: Expose browser control and accessibility snapshots through MCP.
tradeoff: Browser automation can access authenticated browser state when configured to do so.

title: Browser Use
description: Use a model to plan and execute browser interactions from Python.
tradeoff: Local execution still requires a suitable configured model.

title: Stagehand
description: Use browser actions and structured extraction in TypeScript.
tradeoff: AI-driven operations need a configured model.

title: Ollama
description: Run and serve supported language models on local hardware.
tradeoff: Model weights have their own licenses and hardware requirements.

title: llama.cpp
description: Run GGUF models with a native inference engine and optional local HTTP server.
tradeoff: Model conversion and acceleration settings depend on the model and device.

title: Apple MLX
description: Use array operations for machine learning on Apple Silicon.
tradeoff: Language-model generation is provided through companion projects such as MLX LM.

title: MLX LM
description: Generate text and fine-tune supported language models on Apple Silicon.
tradeoff: Model and quantization choices determine memory requirements.

title: Hugging Face Hub client
description: Find and transfer Hub models, datasets and Spaces from Python.
tradeoff: Artifact access and use depend on each publisher's terms.

title: Transformers
description: Run or train supported text, image, audio and multimodal models.
tradeoff: Weights, runtime and acceleration support vary by model.

title: Mem0
description: Retain and retrieve contextual information across agent sessions.
tradeoff: Review retention settings and the configured model and vector store.

title: Letta
description: Build stateful agents with memory managed across interactions.
tradeoff: Persistence and model-provider setup depend on the deployment.

title: Qdrant
description: Search vectors and filter results with metadata conditions.
tradeoff: Self-hosting requires capacity for vector indexes and replication if needed.

title: Chroma
description: Store embeddings and retrieve records by vector similarity.
tradeoff: Embedding provider costs depend on configuration.

title: LlamaIndex
description: Connect data sources, build indexes and retrieve context for model applications.
tradeoff: Storage and model requirements vary by pipeline.

title: LiteLLM
description: Route model calls through a common interface across configured providers.
tradeoff: Provider credentials and usage charges still apply.

title: Promptfoo
description: Define evaluation cases and compare model or prompt configurations.
tradeoff: Evaluation calls can incur charges at configured model providers.

title: Langfuse
description: Track model requests and evaluate application behavior.
tradeoff: Self-hosting includes persistent services and operational upkeep.

title: Guardrails AI
description: Validate model outputs using configurable validators.
tradeoff: Validator coverage and behavior depend on the chosen checks.

title: E2B
description: Create managed sandboxes through an SDK for isolated code execution.
tradeoff: Managed execution requires an account and appropriate quotas.

title: Daytona
description: Create configurable code execution environments through an SDK.
tradeoff: Sandbox resource limits and network policy require review.

title: Cloudflare Agents SDK
description: Build and host stateful agents on Cloudflare Workers.
tradeoff: Production state is coupled to Workers and Durable Objects.

title: MarkItDown
description: Convert supported files to Markdown for downstream processing.
tradeoff: Conversion quality depends on source format and installed extras.

title: SearXNG
description: Combine results from configured search sources in a self-hosted service.
tradeoff: Source availability and terms depend on the configured engines.

title: whisper.cpp
description: Run Whisper speech recognition models locally.
tradeoff: Transcription accuracy depends on model, audio and language.

title: LiveKit Agents
description: Build voice and multimodal sessions with real-time media.
tradeoff: Telephony and provider charges depend on configuration.

title: Pydantic AI
description: Build typed Python agents and validate structured outputs.
tradeoff: Model availability depends on provider configuration.

title: AutoGen
description: Coordinate agent conversations and tool calls in Python.
tradeoff: Check the upstream support status when starting a new project.

title: n8n
description: Connect services and run workflows with visual nodes.
tradeoff: Review the Sustainable Use License before commercial redistribution.

title: Browserbase MCP
description: Expose managed browser sessions through a Browserbase MCP server.
tradeoff: Managed browser execution requires Browserbase credentials.

title: GitHub MCP Server
description: Expose GitHub repository and collaboration operations through MCP.
tradeoff: Review token scopes and configure read-only access for discovery workflows.

title: Postgres MCP
description: Expose PostgreSQL inspection and analysis features through MCP.
tradeoff: Use a database role with only the privileges required for the task.

title: Skills CLI
description: Discover and manage agent skills from upstream repositories.
tradeoff: Review source and license for each skill separately.

title: MCP Reference Servers
description: Reference implementations demonstrate common MCP server patterns.
tradeoff: Each reference server has separate capabilities and permission requirements.

title: Aider
description: Edit repository files from a terminal with a model and review changes through Git.
tradeoff: Review edits and configure the model provider for the task.

title: OpenCode
description: Run a coding agent through a terminal interface or an editor integration.
tradeoff: Review tool permissions and isolate repositories that contain untrusted files.

title: Semgrep
description: Scan source with static analysis rules to identify suspicious code patterns.
tradeoff: Coverage depends on the enabled rules and supported languages.
